name: Purchase of equipment commonly carried by fighters
description: Retail purchases of outdoor, protective, communication or medical gear in unusual quantity shortly before travel.
fp: Hiking, camping and humanitarian volunteering generate the same purchases.

sources.text: FATF, Financing of the Terrorist Organisation Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (2015)
UN Security Council Resolution 2178 (2014) on foreign terrorist fighters
